item.description: 📢 EDF Battleverse Project launches its 1st 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗻 𝗖𝗮𝗹𝗹 ! 📍 The BattleVerse consortium is looking for SMEs and start-ups with innovative solutions for the European defence sector to apply individually or gathered in consortia with up to 3 partners. 📍Applicants are invited to propose innovative solutions in AI-enabled decision support (including Machine Learning, LLMs, strategic decision-making and human-in-the-loop AI), advanced modelling and simulation (including MSaaS, Digital Twins and multi-domain simulation environments), or autonomous defence systems (including unmanned vehicles, distributed AI and swarm operations). ➡️ Up to €60,000 funding will be distributed per beneficiary (maximum €180,000 per experiment) for six-month research experiments, as well as technical coaching and the opportunity to validate their solutions within the BattleVerse innovation ecosystem. 🚨 The application deadline is 16th of November 2026 at 17h00 CET. ➡️ Application platform and guidelines available here: https://lnkd.in/eUgAzVsF ➡️ An online info session for this Call will take place on 6 October 2026 at 10:00 CET. Apply now ! Léo B. item.title: 📌 Save the Date: ENDR Conference ”European Young Professionals Defence Summit 2026” in Malmö on 27 – 28 October 2026 In ...
item.description: 📌 Save the Date: ENDR Conference ”European Young Professionals Defence Summit 2026” in Malmö on 27 – 28 October 2026 In the framework of the European Network of Defence-related Regions - ENDR, the European Commission’s Directorate-General for Defence Industry and Space - DG DEFIS, together with ENDR member Säkerhets- och försvarsföretagen (SOFF) - will host the ENDR conference “European Young Professionals Defence Summit”. Over two days in Malmö, participants will engage with leading experts and decision-makers through keynote speeches, panel discussions, interactive sessions, and networking activities. Discussions will address Europe's changing security environment, the defence market and industrial growth, skills development and workforce needs, and the relationship between technology, innovation, and operational effect. 👉 Further details on the agenda, confirmed speakers and registration on the dedicated webpage: https://lnkd.in/ezPNPPyM. item.title: 📢 Defence and dual-use technologies become eligible to EIC funding instruments ▶️ As a result of an amendment to the EIC...
item.description: 📢 Defence and dual-use technologies become eligible to EIC funding instruments ▶️ As a result of an amendment to the EIC work programme 2026 adopted on 17 June 2026 by the Commission to implement the Defence Mini-Omnibus, the EIC Accelerator and STEP Scaleup will from now on support companies developing dual-use technologies. Start-ups and SMEs developing technologies with a focus on dual-use business cases, both civilian and defence applications, can apply for grants up to €2.5 million and equity investments up to €30 million. ▶️ At the same time, the EIC is launching a new €100 million EIC STEP Defence Scale Up call, allowing companies in the EU Member States and countries associated to Horizon Europe to receive up to €30 million in direct equity financing in sectors such as air and missile defence, drones and counter drones, and other critical defence technologies. 🔎 This is the first time any EU funding programme will ever invest direct equity in defence companies. They can apply from 30 June until 28 October 2026, and the results are expected in early 2027. 👉 More information on the dedicated news article: https://lnkd.in/egVPTANM Léo B. item.title: 🔎Eurobarometer Defence & Space results A new Eurobarometer survey released ahead of the Munich Security Conference shows...
item.description: 🔎Eurobarometer Defence & Space results A new Eurobarometer survey released ahead of the Munich Security Conference shows Europeans’ growing perception of threat for their countries in the current international situation. Key findings of this survey are the following: 📍 68% of Europeans believe their country is under threat 📍52% of Europeans trust the EU to strengthen security and defence 📍74% of respondents approve of the EU’s current level of defence investment or believe that spending should be increased 📍EU space programmes are perceived as essential instruments for addressing defence and security, environment and climate and competitiveness. Léo B. item.title: 📰 Ukraine officially associated to EDF as part of the EU-Ukraine Defence Industrial Partnership! 📌 On 15th July, the Eur...
item.description: 📰 Ukraine officially associated to EDF as part of the EU-Ukraine Defence Industrial Partnership! 📌 On 15th July, the European Commission and Ukraine signed a new defence industrial partnership, enabling Ukrainian and EU companies to accelerate the development of critical defence capabilities, to strengthen joint industrial production and to work together on EU-funded defence research and development. Ukraine has indeed been fully associated to both the European Defence Fund (EDF) and the European Defence Industry Programme (EDIP), enabling Ukrainian and EU companies to form consortia and participate together in collaborative defence research and development projects supported by the Fund. The Commission also launched the EU–Ukraine Drone Deal to deepen cooperation on drone and counter-drone technologies. Finally, the Commission disbursed a further €1 billion to support Ukraine's drone capabilities under the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan. 🔎 More information and quotes in the official press release: https://lnkd.in/gtzbke3E ( 📷 copyrigth picture: Martin Joasaar) Léo B. item.description: 🚨🚨 EDF Work Programme 2026 released! 🚨🚨 Today, the EDF Work Programme 2026 was adopted by the Commission. All work programme files are available on DEFIS’ website: https://lnkd.in/efjYmBqp. The European Defence Fund’s annual Work Programme for 2026 will dedicate €1 billion to support collaborative defence R&D projects. With this new round of investments, the European Commission’s flagship for defence R&D will address 31 collaborative defence R&D topics, in critical and urgent areas in line with the commonly agreed capability development priorities. ▶️ More information on the dedicated press release: https://lnkd.in/eWeVzM-p. item.title: 📢 NFP training workshop and EOA General Assembly under way 📍 As part of the EOA - Enhancing Opportunities for All projec...
item.description: 📢 NFP training workshop and EOA General Assembly under way 📍 As part of the EOA - Enhancing Opportunities for All project the Croatian Defense Industry Competitiveness Cluster (CDICC) currently hosts in Slovenia the second training workshop for EDF National Focal Points, alternates, and other members of national EDF teams, aiming to strengthen NFP’s practical EDF support knowledge and skills. A particular focus is set on the Slovenian EDF experience (both from EDF consortium leaders and partners) and the management of IPR in EDF projects. The EOA project consortium took advantage of this onsite gathering to hold its annual General Assembly. To close the 3-day workshop the Slovenian Ministry of Defence will tomorrow present its experience with EDF participation and emerging challenges. Participants will also be introduced to the GOIS Grozd obrambne industrije Slovenije, g.i.z. with discussions on national approaches to innovation, research and development, and the exchange of good practices. ⏪ You can replay previous EOA training and webinar sessions on EDF best practices are available on EOA’s Youtube channel: https://lnkd.in/euKYVBz2. Stay tuned ! 🎙️ Aleš Lipnik, Doit-R Solutions Aleksander majeric, TECES, Green Tech Cluster), coordinator of the INDY, Energy independent and efficient deployable military camps project (EDF 2021) and partner in NOMAD PROJECT EU(EDF 2021) and Sentinel Project (EDF 2024) Iztok Spacapan, Instrumentation Technologies and the ARCHYTAS (EDF) project (EDF 2023) Žiga Mlinarič, SkyLabs d.o.o. and the Staalion project (EDF 2023 SME development action project) Jan Knezevic, SSRD and the Small UAS project (EDF 2024) Ziga Brencic, Jozef Stefan Institute and the SQORPION project (EDF 2024) 🙋‍♂️ Léo B., Alain Dinis 💡 🌎, Alexandre Hervin, Joachim Finkielman, Paloma López Diez, Václav Syruček, Victor Hartong, Kristýna Helm, Goran Basarac, Grubesic Bruno The European Network of Defence-related Regions, European Defence Fund, Aerospace, Security and Defence Industries Association of Europe (ASD), European Union Security and Defence, European Defence Agency.

item.description: 📢 EU defence funding news! 📢 📌EDF 2025 figures A record 410 project proposals were submitted under EDF 2025 calls for collaborative defence research and development actions, marking an unprecedented level of interest since its launch in 2021, and representing an increase of 38% compared to 2024. Evaluation results are expected to be announced in April 2026. More information on EDF 2025: https://lnkd.in/dxzhH64x 📌 Political agreement reached on the European Defence Industry Programme (EDIP) Along with the adoption of EU’s Defence Readiness Roadmap 2030 and a budget of €1.5 billion for 2025–2027, EDIP will accelerate the industrialisation of defence products, industrial ramp-up, support to European supply chains and SMEs, and the development of Ukraine's defence technological and industrial base. More information on specific rules and the timeline: https://lnkd.in/eVZP8hWH. item.title: 📢 5 new large-scale European Defence Projects of Common Interest (EDPCIs) to strengthen industrial capacities of the Eur...
item.description: 📢 5 new large-scale European Defence Projects of Common Interest (EDPCIs) to strengthen industrial capacities of the European Union 👇 On 3rd July 2026, the European Commission proposed EDPCIs on five priority areas: drones and counter-drone systems; maritime and seabed defence; space; air and missile defence; as well as strengthening security along the EU's Eastern Flank. ▶️ EDPCIs which will provide a framework for EU countries to work together on large and complex defence initiatives improving the EU's ability to respond to shared security challenges, in line with NATO capability priorities. It is worth mentioning that Ukraine participates in four of the five projects. Next steps: After the adoption of the list of identified EDPCIs by the Council, those will become eligible to receive up to €325 million through EDIP through a dedicated procedure, enabling the projects’ initial deployment and lay the foundation for possible further funding via the upcoming European Competitiveness Fund. 🔎 More information and factsheets here: https://lnkd.in/dTKEcZSX Léo B. item.description: ☑️ Reminder: the call for Local Organisers of the next BraveTech EU DefTech Forges remains open! BraveTechEU brings together the European Defence Fund, EUDIS, the European Defence Agency and BRAVE1. From 9–16 November 2026, selected organisations will host five-day intensive test campaigns together with local end-users and the consortium, helping technologies mature where they matter most. BraveTechEU is looking for innovation hubs, accelerators, testing centres, tech parks, and ecosystem builders willing to become trusted local nodes within the EU–Ukraine defence innovation network. As a Local Organiser, you will co-deliver a proven high-impact programme with the Civitta · Starburst · Darkstar consortium to support technologies addressing real operational needs, work directly with startups, SMEs, military users, and defence stakeholders, and strengthen your local defence innovation ecosystem. 📅 Application deadline: 15 July 2026 🎥 Learn more about the DefTech Forges: https://lnkd.in/eWkMfrR5 👉 Apply to host a DefTech Forge: https://tally.so/r/MerQd0 Léo B. item.title: 📢 5th edition of EDA’s Test & Evaluation Community Days on “Strengthening European T&E for AI-Enabled and Autonomous Sys...
item.description: 📢 5th edition of EDA’s Test & Evaluation Community Days on “Strengthening European T&E for AI-Enabled and Autonomous Systems” From 29 September to 1 October 2026, the European Defence Agency will hold the Test and Evaluation Community Days in Kiel, Germany. This 5th edition will bring together key European stakeholders to examine how Test & Evaluation (T&E) can better support defence readiness and accelerate capability development. Discussions will address topics such as wartime experience, Test and Evaluation resources in Europe, challenges in testing autonomous system, the role of AI in T&E, the need to attract and train the next generation of T&E experts, and the contribution of T&E to certification and qualification processes, including initiatives such as the Joint Ammunition Qualification (JAQ). If you wish to present a contribution aligned with the above-mentioned topics of interest, please complete the submission form by 26 June 2026 and send it to the organizers. Submission forms and registrations here: https://lnkd.in/efDM7_gv Léo B. item.title: 📢 MAJoR consortium attracts more than 200 proposals in its EDF’s first-ever FSTP sub-call ▶️ The MAJoR consortium receiv...
item.description: 📢 MAJoR consortium attracts more than 200 proposals in its EDF’s first-ever FSTP sub-call ▶️ The MAJoR consortium received more than 200 proposals in their first FSTP sub-call from almost all Member States, including Ukraine, with over 70% of eligible applicants participating in an EU defence funding programme for the first time. ▶️ This resonates with one of our recent posts on the introduction of FSTP under EDF, through which the MAJoR project aims to select up to 60 innovators to contribute with their specialized technologies and expertise to the targeted innovation challenges within the project, without navigating the full EDF application process. Successful applicants will receive up to €60,000 in funding and participate in a 6-month business development support programme. A total of 3.6 million EUR is reserved for both sub-calls within MAJoR. 📍 Next steps Looking ahead, the second MAJoR sub-call and the first sub-call under the BATTLEVERSE project, will take place, offering further opportunities for innovative companies to participate in EDF-funded projects. 🚀More information on FSTP in EDF: https://lnkd.in/eisZFtrF Léo B.
